title: Voice Typing Android: Keep Your Keyboard, Add a Floating Mic
description:
Voice typing Android without replacing your keyboard. See AI Dictation's floating mic in a current Android build.

Try AI Dictation: https://aidictation.com
Open-source code: https://github.com/writingmate/aidictation
Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aidictation.app

AI Dictation uses microphone and Accessibility access, with your consent, to recognize speech and insert finished text into supported editable fields. Password and other secure fields are excluded. Offline recognition may require a model download. Cloud transcription or cleanup may send relevant audio or text for remote processing. Availability and insertion can vary by app and Android restrictions.
